summary: Examples of import_tasks: importing a file mid-play and applying a condition to all imported tasks.
questions: How do I apply a when to every task in an imported file?
What does import_tasks syntax look like?

answer_card.title: import_tasks examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
    file: stuff.yaml
- ansible.builtin.import_tasks: stuff.yaml
  when: hostvar is defined   # applied to each task
```
